performance.verdict: All paid activity dead since Sep 17; GA4 uptick is organic noise, not recovery.

findings.text: All spend dropped to $0 from Sep 17 onward (11 consecutive zero-spend days); leads, Meta, and Google all confirm full pause — $0 spend_per_day_7d.
5 overdue SOW milestones (earliest Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL build gaps, end-to-end stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch — all unconfirmed complete.
Google Ads spent $354.66 over 28 days and recorded 0 conversions; 69 clicks with zero pipeline entries confirm a confirmed tracking or attribution break, not a volume problem.
GHL shows 106 opportunities created vs 90 reported leads, 0 won, 0 appointments — 16 unmatched opps and zero downstream movement signals an intake routing or assignment leak.
GA4 sessions rose to 41–56 on Sep 25–26 despite zero paid spend; organic lift is real but directional only — GBP drove 38 directions in 28 days with just 1 call.

suggestions.text: Identify and resolve the cause of the full paid pause before restoring any budget — confirm billing, policy, or manual pause on both Meta and Google.
suggestions.monday_update: All paid spend went to $0 on Sep 17 and has remained there for 11 days across both Meta ($0) and Google ($0). Before any budget is restored, confirm whether this was a manual pause, billing failure, or policy flag on both platforms. Success is confirmed when spend resumes and daily leads return to the Aug 31–Sep 16 baseline of 4–12/day. Resolve by Oct 1.

suggestions.text: Fix Google Ads conversion tracking — $354.66 spent over 28 days with 0 conversions recorded; pixel or import must be verified before any Google budget is restored.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads spent $354.66 over the past 28 days and reported 0 conversions against 69 clicks — this is a confirmed tracking break, not a performance problem. Audit the conversion action in Google Ads (pixel firing, GHL/GA4 import, or call tracking tag). Success is confirmed when at least one test conversion registers in the Google Ads UI. Complete before any Google budget is re-enabled.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake routing: 106 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — confirm lead-to-opp assignment and 16 unmatched records before ads resume.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 106 opportunities and 134 contacts against 90 reported leads, with 0 appointments and 0 won — 16 records are unaccounted for and no lead has progressed through the pipeline. This must be resolved alongside the overdue end-to-end stack re-test (due Aug 31). Confirm each intake path routes to the correct pipeline stage and that the Becklar billing drop and BWS duplicate checks are verified. Success is confirmed when a test lead travels end-to-end and appears correctly in one opportunity with full field mapping. Target: Oct 2.
